body.condition: For every \(c\in\mathcal C\), the true conditional survival is strictly positive at every required cell horizon almost surely, \(Q_c(\max_{1\le\ell\le d_c}t_{c\ell}\mid X_{ci})>0\); and, for every fold \(f\), the selected learner satisfies \(\widehat Q_{c,-f}(\max_{1\le\ell\le d_c}t_{c\ell}\mid X_{ci})>0\) almost surely on an event whose probability tends to one.
